text:
Glad it works for you. By my clock it's only 2:00 PM Eastern on Thursday, so if you're feeling the lateness, maybe you're in a different time zone, or it's just been a long week or a long stretch of the school year.

One more thing before you finalize: HS-LS3-2 expects students to connect inheritable variation to meiosis (new allele combinations through crossing over and independent assortment) as well as to replication errors and environmental mutagens. The draft covers the latter two but not meiosis. A single lesson in Week 2 linking meiosis to Mendel's laws would close that gap and make the Punnett square work more conceptually grounded.

Good luck with the rest of your planning, and get some rest.
